notes.title: The Turtle Update v1.1.0
notes.notes:
[p]Hello there![/p][p]
Here’s another update, bringing the game to version 1.1.0! This one focuses mainly on 🐢 turtle stuff and adds a small new level:[/p][list][*][p]Eïko (the main character) now has a [b]little surfing animation[/b] when the turtle moves at medium speed. At high speed, he still crouches as before.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]turtle[/b] can now perform a [b]little trick while jumping[/b]! Just press the jump button again during the leap and enjoy. It has no gameplay purpose—it's just for fun 😄.[/p][/*][*][p]A new collectible item has been added: [b]the compass[/b]! When using the turtle, it displays a UI showing the cardinal directions. This should help you choose a global direction on the map and stick to it without constantly checking.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/5599b16dfc583f7164d0401fe07e5ceae65bd259.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]And this new item is hidden in a small, optional [b]new area: the Pirate Base[/b]. You'll have to look for it across the ocean. It might be a bit tedious to find if you already finished the main quest, but it should be easy to stumble across while exploring if you're discovering the game.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/cd93d5cc81894f1a2a6f3b3f0950e12f0959c43f.png"][/img][/p][p]That’s it! I hope you'll enjoy this little update 💙[/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget to [b]follow my Steam developer page[/b] if you don't want to miss anything in the future: [/p][p]👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/oneiricworlds"]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/oneiricworlds[/url] [/p][p][/p][p]As always, thank you so much for the kind support![/p][p]Have a great day! Take care, peace ✌![/p][p]
[/p][p]Mathias (the dev)[/p]

notes.title: Update v1.0.47
notes.notes:
Hello,

Here's another quick patch:
[list]
[*] Fix a possible death loop in water dungeon on breakable blocks
[*] At the end of the Clandestine Factory (desert tower), better show the chest with the magnetic bow upgrade
[*] Add help to move in the credits
[*] The name of the dog is now displayed in blue for better readability
[*] Add a little humorous help sign near the weight switch in desert tower
[*] the entrance of desert tower in now breakable/explodable from both sides in case you forget to explode it from the inside
[*] Buying items in the shop (bombs, apples, arrow) is now much faster. You still have to press the button 20x if you want 20 bombs, but it's way more fun and reactive.
[*] Fix a possible soft lock when getting out of Kisugi Tower by the bottom lift.
[*] Added Carlos Benedito as a proof reader for Spanish in the credits, thanks a lot for your time and expertise Carlos!.
[/list] 
By the way, I also take the chance to list and thank all the translators of the game who did an amazing job:
[list]
[*] English: Anneline Fontmarty
[*] Spanish : my dad Francis Fontmarty
[*] Portuguese from Brazil: Rinaldo Alípio Bueno who also made A TON of feedback as a beta tester and who achieved to complete 100% when the game was still broken and missed a few detectors. Crazy job there my friend.
[/list]
So thank you very much to this kind people, and thanks to you too, dear readers and players, for giving me the amazing feedback and reporting bugs after launch, this helps me to fix the game as soon as possible.

Don't forget to leave a review if you haven't already, or speak about the game to your friends if you found it cool! I must say the sales are not that great now, despite some super nice reviews. 🙏🙏🙏

You are gold. Have a great day, take care, peace!

Mathias, the dev.

notes.title: Revelation Melody - Update v1.0.46
notes.notes: [p]Hello there,[/p][p][/p][p]As promised, I've been working on a new mechanics to help you find these last missing items/animals/flowers. Some of them can be pretty hard to find (yes, I'm looking at you Prison levels), so here it is! From now on (v1.0.46):[/p][list][*][p]There's a new very expensive melody sheet you can buy at Aqualums Painting shop[/p][/*][*][p]Each time you play this "Revelation Melody", light rays will appear around animals, flowers, chests, paintings and a few key items too. This will only work 30 seconds in the local/current level.[/p][/*][/list][p]Here's how it looks like:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/008afd3390988834b4f9a10a9f75b6f30253576d.png"][/img][/p][p]Guess what? It also works on sea creatures:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/ab556b1cbf2988d67bc3815070a42e2f17e586de.png"][/img][/p][p]I hope this will help you! So why a buyable melody?[/p][p]1 - So that you can choose to use it or not (it's not a passive skill), and it relies on an already existing mechanics. Plus, I initially planned to add a 4th melody that I removed because I couldn't find a nice fit. Now we're talking! And I'm pretty sure some of you would still like to go hardcore with no hints. It's up to you 😊[/p][p]2 - Now the big money you have in the end game will be of some use. Of course, given it's pretty expensive, you won't be able to afford it before approaching the 100%, but that's when it's gonna be the most useful.[/p][p][/p][p]Anyways, if you've already reached the 100%, your completion rate will go down to 99% in your save slot (because of the missing new melody sheet). But you'll keep your 100% Steam achievement.[/p][p][/p][p]By the way, I improved the computation of the completion rate because flowers were getting all the attention (given there are more than 600...). Now it's more balanced, giving equal importance to quests, inventory, status or animals.[/p][p][/p][p]Hope you'll like it![/p][p]Have a great day, take care, peace![/p][p][/p][p]Mathias, the dev[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.45
notes.notes:
Hello there,

The latest update brings the following improvements:
[list]
[*] the vsync option is now correctly initialized at start, reading your previous settings.
[*] bigger hit collider for the lava boss (so it's a bit easier to [spoiler]shoot him with fruits. Lots of people tought that it wasn't the way to go because it didn't react due to a too small collider[/spoiler])
[*] in the desert pagoda, the room blocked by sand is not visible on the map anymore to avoid sending mixed signals: you just CANT go there.
[*] At the Governor's Garden, the ill dog is now quacking occasionnally to help you find it more easily. Plus it's absolutely logical given the ill ducks are barking.
[*] On Eolia & Aqualums, there are now wooden panels with text/symbols above the doors you can enter. 
[*] In the Cells, I fixed positions, sizes and visibility of a few flowers that were quite hard to notice/find. I'm still working on a nice way to help you reach the 100% and find the last missing items. This shall come in the next releases
[*] The main lift in the Robot Factory now reinits at lower position each time you reload the level. This enables to go back up anytime you want. Some of you told me it was frustrating because the pirate chase forces you to leave the island before completing it. And if you come back, you can't get up again because the lift stayed in upper position. Of course, you could still get back later with the grapple, but it was a friction point indeed. So NOW you can come back anytime you want, still get up there and complete the island sooner, before getting the grapple.
[/list]

As always, thanks a lot for your feedback, it is awesome! I keep working to improve the game.
Have a great day, take care, peace!

Mathias, the dev

notes.title: 🎉 Release Date Reveal – Zefyr Launches June 2nd, 2025! 🐢

I've updated the trailer on the Steam page, but you can also watch it right here:
[previewyoutube=inu1ZpmNrKo;full][/previewyoutube]

The beta test is coming to an end, and while I still need to finish a few music tracks and sound effects, everything is on track for release!

I’ve reached out to the press to announce the release date — so it’s now official! 🎉
That said, media coverage has been modest so far (I’m still a pretty small fish 🐟), but if you're part of the press or a journalist, feel free to check out the official press release here:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1344990]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1344990[/url]

See you soon on the other side!
Take care, Peace! ✌️

Mathias, the dev

notes.title: Steam Next Fest & Spanish Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The demo and prologue of Zefyr are now available in a new language: Spanish (from Spain)! I hope it’s also relevant for Latin American players too.
Of course, the full game will also be translated, but since this part is done, I decided to push the update to Steam right away!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/0f9efc875e19bfcc30e7a1f1d10291571a6dd650.jpg[/img]
By the way, it was my dad who localized the game! He's a retired Spanish professor. I hope everything is accurate, but don’t hesitate to let me know if you spot any typos or if certain words could be improved. He speaks Spanish very well, but since he's not a gamer, some terms might be a little off. Any feedback is welcome!

It was super nice working with him—it brought back memories of my old Spanish lessons at school!

On another note, the demo will be featured in Steam Next Fest next week (October, 14th). I really hope the game will reach a much larger audience. Fingers crossed! :)

And a piece of good news to wrap up this quick post: the full game has made it onto Steam's "Most Wishlisted Games" list, which is a huge milestone for a solo, unknown dev like me. Of course, I’m near the bottom of the charts, but it should still give me a bit more visibility for the full release.

Thanks so much for your continued support! Feel free to follow my dev page on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/oneiricworlds

Have a great day, and take care.

Peace!

notes.title: Prologue Release & Polish
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I hope you’re all doing well. This month has been packed with updates and improvements to Zefyr, and I’m excited to share them with you. Here’s what I’ve been working on:


[h1]I – Steam Builds[/h1]

Now there are Steam Achievements for the prologue, the demo, and the full game. I’ve built and deployed the prologue version on Steam, and updated the demo with the latest fixes. I’ve also written a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2320250/view/4256546298615291428]Steam post[/url] stating the Deck Compatibility.

[h2]AND HERE’S THE BIG ANNOUNCEMENT:
THE PROLOGUE WILL RELEASE ON JULY 22ND![/h2]

Check it out here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2320250/Zefyr_Prologue/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2320250/Zefyr_Prologue/[/url]

In case you don’t know, the prologue is a free version of a game. In my case, it’s the exact same thing as the demo but it reaches a different audience on Steam. If you [b]want to help me[/b], the best way is to[b] play the (free) prologue[/b] on the release day and [b]leave a review[/b]! This helps a lot for the visibility of my game.


[h1]II – Polish & Content[/h1]

I’ve mainly polished the 3rd chapter:

[list]
[*] Villa Level: I’ve added details to the kitchen, bathroom, and more cushions and furniture. There’s also a cute cat roaming around now!
[*] Green Island: added towers, rocks, stone walls, and hidden rewards.
[*] Mines: Designed a specific font for text and used it on screens and panels. I’ve also added buckets, picks, and wires to enrich the environment.
[*] Robot Factory: Enhanced with stencils, screens, wires, and improved ambiance to give it a more industrial feel.
[*] Aeolia Island: more flowers to make the world vibrant and colorful, better stone placement, more vegetation.
[/list]

A few screens:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/4add67ce7c50ede62f73597f583c8048ed39cf85.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/888fc82bfa4d32d295bac6d3edcced287b258b6c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/7b7bf8d823813011d78c3e8a189273eae282ecbb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/ad8ca6f604d924aa6be66555db1f95e50d84d596.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/ea15ae8a305af420b0c6843567740b2d063cbcc7.jpg[/img]

To balance gameplay, eating 3 chocolates now grants 1 additional heart. This allows to place more rewards in levels without overpowering the player. Plus it gives a good feeling of progression.


[h1]III – New Link UI[/h1]

I’ve been wanting to redesign the link UI for a while now, (some people have been asking for it). So here it is:

[list]
[*] UI Overhaul: There’s now a new, more intuitive tab-based navigation.
[*] Status: Added a new status page that shows the game main items to unlock.
[*] Help: Improved the help section for better player guidance.
[*] Animals: Added detailed descriptions for all animals in the game.
[*] Maps: I’ve also updated the rendering of maps, with shaders and outlines to ensure visual consistency and readability. It took quite some time to fix all the rendering bugs due to projection maths for the clip planes.
[*] Avatars: The flute avatar has been tweaked to distinguish it from the bo staff, and avatars for certain bosses have been updated.
[/list]

Here’s how it look like:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/40e292c31ed9ff0af2e48ad0e4dd74065dd67d68.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/1b36b627bbc1c6ac38999b3a67f8358d9eac38a1.jpg[/img]

[h1]IV – Mesh Generator Tool[/h1]

I’ve developed a new mesh generator tool to speed up the creation of vegetation. This tool allows me to generate detailed and varied plant life much faster, enhancing the level design processing significantly (from 20 mn to 10 s on some levels). Plus it’s lighter on memory so it doesn’t crash anymore on super dense levels. What a breeze!


[h1]V – Bugs & Fixes[/h1]

Lots of bug fixes, among which:

[list]
[*] Resolved issues with instantiating two map cameras
[*] Fixed lots of glitched click and select functions
[*] Optimized the UI for better performance and resolved button overlap issues
[*] Tested the UI from 5:4 screen ratio to 21:9 to ensure compatibility across different screen sizes
[*] Level Design: made numerous small fixes to improve overall level design
[/list]

That’s all for this month! Thank you for your continued support and patience. Stay tuned for more updates, and take care!

Peace!

notes.title: Happy New Year & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello there, and a Happy New Year to all of you! I wish you health, joy, happy moments with family and friends, and fulfillment in your projects.

On my side, the last month has been quite productive with lots of little enhancements. It’s quite pleasing to see all these small upgrades slowly propagate through the entire game.


[h1]Level Upgrade[/h1]

First, I worked on the visual upgrade of an old level that was far behind the others. I can’t show too much without spoiling, but you can check this out:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/30c9f3bec5818fdab5879ec286d2e88dac3aea2c.jpg[/img]
Still some work to do, but it’s already much more understandable than the previous “blocking state” look. I added crates, fabrics, desks, armchairs, sofas, pinboards, billboards, plants, arches, and architectural elements.


[h1]Doors & Enemies[/h1]

I also took some time to start working on two things that were on my to-do list for a long time: signaling locked doors to players and adding contextual idle animations to enemies to tell a story without explicit dialogs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/a84603d7bdea298452f25e966c87f33d1bf2e6ab.jpg[/img]
Here you can see a mining robot. Yeah, I guess it’s better with animation and sound.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/bde8d7274341c7ac8b418b0381607d93226ec7da.jpg[/img]
I used some kind of “hologram” to display the locked state of the door. I also use the hologram look on various other screens/displays/technological stuff throughout the world, so I thought that was the most logical thing to do. Plus, it’s pretty immediate to understand.


[h1]Unexpected Complexity[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/b1b790eb44bda3f769d3ae8d27da72bd0f1fa40e.jpg[/img]
At some point, I added a super small improvement: displaying the maximum number of items that the player can collect. Surprisingly, this led to tricky questions about what I should do with unpickable items: destroy them? But when? What if the player can eat a few apples to regenerate her life and THEN free up some space to grab the apple on the ground? If the apple is destroyed the first time she tries to pick it, this feels unfair. Then should items be left on the ground? For how long? Should it be saved? What happens if the player moves to another island and gets back? And what will be the feedback for players to understand that they can’t take the item? It’s much more complex than one can expect, actually…


[h1]Many Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h1]

In the end, I worked on ~ 250 fixes and updates, among which:

[list]
[*] fix old collision bugs
[*] fix bugs regarding missions, stories and dialogs
[*] fix animation of robots & pirates
[*] fix dialog translation
[*] fix confusing stuff
[*] fix graphical stuff (textures, reflection probes, particles, outline, cutscenes, shaders, bubble font size for 4K) on chapter 2
[*] clean database (old prefabs)
[*] fix old bugs arising from mode conflicts (what happens when cutscene+dialog+power up at the same time for exemple ?)
[*] add NPC Reno in zoological center + power up animal detector
[*] add accesibility option for camera moves
[*] improve full item capacity handling & feedback
[*] add fx & sfx for steps on terrain, rain, snow & breath in cold
[*] clean/organization on disk for il2cpp compilation (optimized build & console compatible)
[*] improve saves: bugs fix, clean & compatible steam save
[*] upload test build to steam
[/list]

And that’s it ! As always, thank you immensely for your ongoing support! I truly hope to be able to show the final game this year. If you want to support me financially (if you don’t already) you can check out my [url=https://www.patreon.com/oneiricworlds]Patreon[/url]. Thanks a loooooot !

Peace !

notes.title: Polish & Demo Release
notes.notes:
Hello there!

It’s time for a quick game update! So, what’s new this month?


[h1]I – Polish[/h1]

I have mainly focused on polishing various systems, including maps, dialogs, and some sounds:

[list]
[*] Maps: I have made significant improvements to the maps by handcrafting them. Previously, they were top-down renders, which looked cool but were not very understandable. Many meshes were overlapping, making it difficult for players to identify the platforms. Therefore, I took the time to design the maps manually for each level of the demo. I hope this has made them much more readable. Additionally, I have also reworked the icons, avatars, and map borders. Check it out:
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/5bd9171a52624afc6f1b556e463189ba6e30af4c.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/807d534c95f7945e668628dcf0fcb43096b9bbb6.jpg[/img]Maps showing 2 floors of the same level.

[list]
[*] Dialogs: to make the texts and dialogs more engaging, I integrated a third-party library called “Text Animator for Unity” (https://www.febucci.com/text-animator-unity/). I initially had a custom-made system to display letters one by one, and I started exploring how to dynamically add shaking, growing, or shrinking effects. However, as I delved deeper into it, I realized that coding it correctly would take quite some time. Therefore, I opted for an existing library that already offers these functionalities. This has improved the dialog box and I have also reworked the speech bubbles that appear when characters speak. Additionally, I added interjections, especially when the player jumps.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/cc69f03517eeef2a5c29c180f6c2f3047ed1566b.jpg[/img]Little interjections to give a bit more life to the character.

[list]
[*] Sound Design: I have continued working on sound design, focusing this time on animal sounds such as ducks, cats, dogs, fennec foxes, and sheep. I have also worked on item sounds for doors, chests, arrow blocks, and cannons.
[/list]


[h1]II – Next Demo[/h1]

OK, with all these improvements plus working on the content of the 1st chapter, I can finally see the finish line for the demo release. In fact…

[h2][b]I plan to release the demo in July.[/b][/h2]

I have just completed a “release candidate” build and will start sharing keys for people to test. So stay tuned for the upcoming announcements! It’s a significant achievement for me after all these years to finally be able to consider a part of the game “DONE.” Of course, there will be bugs and things to fix, but in terms of content, intention, and quality, I believe it’s all there… (for the demo, of course, not for the final game).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/29e403a23cf606a9df50b6236f65290ba29b05d9.jpg[/img]Some new content: a species of flower.

Very soon, you will be able to tell all your friends, “Go check out this crazy indie dev” if you want to spread the word, of course 🙂

As for the rest of the game, another tester has completed it (making a total of 4 people, including myself). There is still a lot to correct and fix, but I am gradually bringing it up to the quality level of the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/539ee212b910a5d92212d330ebec88133ecccda8.jpg[/img]The first playable version of the home island from 2014.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38727857/03c7208846f2152235c8e4f37a25f0f1316b43dd.jpg[/img]Final version of the home island. And yes, now you can see all the other islands in the world. Quite some progress!


[h1]III – Communication[/h1]

Regarding the marketing, here are two main updates:

[list]
[*] First, I tried running Reddit ads, and the results are quite interesting. It has gradually increased the number of wishlists, so I think I’ll continue with this strategy and work on optimizing the process.
[*] Secondly, I have created a Discord server as some people have requested. Here’s the link if you want to join: [url=https://discord.gg/bPnUzNrjyd]https://discord.gg/bPnUzNrjyd[/url]. However, there isn’t much to do or see on it at the moment. I’ll use it to share important news and updates, of course.
[/list]
And, as always, I’ve been focusing on bug fixes and code cleaning. I won’t bore you with the details.

I hope you found this update interesting. As always, thank you so much for your support and patience, and I’ll see you next month!


Take care and peace!
